summary: The Community edition now installs from GitHub into your own tenant in one step.

new.title: Install the Community edition from GitHub
new.text: Clone the repository and run the one-step deploy to set up the Manager, engine and database in your own Azure subscription, with Microsoft Entra sign-in. See Getting started.

fixes.title: Community install completes without the updater
fixes.text: Without a release feed the deploy skips the updater and tells you how to update: pull the latest version and run the same command again.

fixes.title: A missing smoke test no longer rolls back
fixes.text: A deploy without its automated smoke test is now recorded as unverified instead of being rolled back.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: Sign-in consent is granted reliably, creating the deploy identity works on a busy directory, and the documentation and screenshots are refreshed.
